name: Short-lived access token
description: The bearer token returned by the OAuth flow that authorizes Dropbox API calls for a user or team and app pair, and which expires after a short period.

blockers.summary: Dropbox documentation states no prefix, alphabet or length for access tokens.
Length and prefix per token kind and date would need issued tokens, which are not created here.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
